findings.played: attack the player with GD01-031 Gelgoog [attack(50,-2)]
findings.better: attack GD01-008 Guntank (or ST01-005 GM) with GD01-031 Gelgoog [attack(50,38)] / [attack(50,9)]
findings.reason: Gelgoog+M'Quve was linked, AP5 HP4, with <Breach 1>. P0 had no base, and all three of its units were rested. Attacking the rested Guntank (AP1 HP2) or GM (AP2, 1 HP left) kills the unit, Gelgoog survives at 3/4 or 2/4, and Breach 1 destroys P0's top shield. That is the same shield damage as the face attack plus a free unit kill. P0 had 0 active resources, so it could not respond.

findings.played: select GD04-012 Core Booster (Marida Cruz [Attack] ping, Kshatriya attacking Core Booster)
findings.reason: Kshatriya (AP7) attacked Core Booster, which had 3 HP left, so the 1-damage ping on Core Booster had no value: Core Booster died in battle anyway, and P0 had 0 active resources to intervene. The only other target, Gundam (3/3), would have dropped to 2 HP for P0's turn. That is a small but positive gain. Minor.

findings.played: attack the player with GD01-001 Gundam (+Hawk of Endymion as pilot) [attack(5,-2)]
findings.better: play ST04-013 Hawk of Endymion as a command to return the 1-HP Kshatriya+Marida to hand, then attack the rested Zaku II with Gundam (kill it and survive), then deploy GM and ST01-001 Gundam
findings.reason: P0 had 3 shields, no base and no Blocker. P1 already had 3 attackers (Gelgoog, Zaku II, Kshatriya) that would untap, so one more linked attacker from P1's 4-card hand and 6 resources would be lethal, and that is what happened. The face hit only took P1 from 2 shields to 1, and P0 could not win that turn. Removing two of P1's three attackers was the safer line. Marked arguable because it was a race.

findings.played: no [no()] (decline Full Frontal's [When Paired] free deploy)
findings.better: yes, and deploy GD04-040 Schuzrum-Galluss (or Rick Dom / Zee Zulu) from hand for free
findings.reason: Full Frontal's [When Paired] deploys a Lv4-or-lower (Neo) Zeon unit at no cost (ruling Q145), and there was no downside. P0 still had 3 shields that could reveal Bursts (two did trigger), so the lethal was not guaranteed, and the extra body was free insurance. The game was won that turn, so the impact was nil, but the decision was strictly dominated.

items.notes: The resource count a/b includes EX resources, and the (...,1) option variants pay with the EX resource. So P0 ending turn 2 (#5) with only the EX resource left was not counted as passivity. Considered and not flagged: #1/#2 redraws; #8 Guntank deployed with no rested target for its [Deploy]; #9 P0 holding GM back and keeping 1 resource for Hawk; #13 Hawk returning Rick Dom instead of the attacking Zee Zulu; #31 Core Booster attacking face (destroying Zanzibar) instead of trading with Gelgoog; #38 burst Close Combat on Guntank rather than the 1-HP GM; #57 Gelgoog trading with the Gundam (Breach kept the shield count the same, and lethal still followed).

findings.played: pass [pass()] (action step of Char's Zaku II attacking ST01-001 Gundam+Amuro Ray)
findings.better: play ST03-012 Indignation [play_command(53,0)] on ST03-006 Char's Zaku II
findings.reason: Char's Zaku II (AP3, HP2) was attacking the rested linked Gundam+Amuro (AP5, HP5/5). Char's Zaku II was going to die anyway. Indignation (cost 1, AP+2; P1 had 3 active resources and two copies) makes it AP5 and destroys P0's best unit, a linked Gundam with Repair 2 and a team AP aura, two cards. P0 had 0 active resources and could not respond. Passing turned the attack into 3 damage that Repair 2 mostly heals.

findings.played: select ST03-008 Zaku II [select(67)] (Char's Zaku II [Destroyed] search)
findings.reason: Schuzrum-Galluss (Lv4, cost 2, 4/3) is a much stronger card than ST03-008 Zaku II (Lv2, cost 1, 1/2, +2 AP on attack), and P1 was already at Lv4. Zaku II fit this turn's curve and is Zeon (Zanzibar/M'Quve synergy), so arguable.

findings.played: play ST03-006 Char's Zaku II [play_unit(62,0)] (hard-cast for 2)
findings.better: play GD01-125 Zanzibar [play_base(61,0)], deploy Char's Zaku II free with its [Deploy], then play ST03-008 Zaku II with the last resource
findings.reason: Inefficient sequencing. For the same 3 resources P1 could have had a 5-HP base, the shield card in hand and the same two units, instead of just the two units. P1 had no base. Zanzibar was cast the next turn for a similar free deploy, so P1 lost about 2 resources of tempo. Arguable because the timing of a base play is a judgement call.

findings.played: attack ST03-008 Zaku II [58] (unpaired, AP1 HP2/2) with ST01-001 Gundam+Amuro [attack(9,58)]
findings.better: attack ST03-008 Zaku II [67] (+M'Quve, AP2 HP1/3, Breach) with Gundam+Amuro [attack(9,67)]
findings.reason: Both Zaku IIs were rested, and the 6-AP Gundam kills either one. The paired Zaku is worth two cards (Zaku plus M'Quve), has higher AP and <Breach 1>. Killing it costs only 1 extra damage on a Repair-2 unit, which is healed by end of turn anyway. Leaving it alive let it (with Indignation) kill Gundam+Amuro next turn and Breach a shield.

items.notes: Considered and not flagged: #5 P0 not spending the EX resource on a second GM on turn 2; #33 Guntank deployed with no [Deploy] target (the leftover resource had no other use); #36 P0 keeping a 2-HP Gundam+Amuro home; #47-#55 P0's turn-10 attacks (good apart from #54); #72 Kshatriya destroying Jaburo instead of a rested Gundam (it set up P1's lethal race and worked). #76: P0 at 2 shields with no base raced (P1 to 0 shields) instead of killing Kshatriya with two units. Both lines were bad, and the race had Burst equity, so I could not call it clearly wrong. #57/#71 trigger ordering (Repair) was irrelevant.

findings.played: attack the player with GD01-031 Gelgoog [attack(43,-2)] (Isaribi 5 -> 1 HP)
findings.better: attack ST05-002 Gundam Barbatos 2nd Form+Mikazuki Augus with Gelgoog [attack(43,96)]
findings.reason: P0 had 2 shields, no base and no Blocker. P1 had two rested linked attackers (Adapt+Mikazuki AP4, 2nd Form+Mikazuki AP6) that would untap, plus 7 resources and cards in hand, so a single extra linked attacker meant lethal, and that is what happened. 2nd Form was at 3 HP, so Gelgoog (AP4) kills it and trades one card for two. P1 had 0 active resources to respond. That removes a 6-AP attacker and forces P1 to find two new attackers. The face hit only left Isaribi at 1 HP and did not give P0 lethal next turn (it would still need 3 attacks with 2 units).

items.notes: Considered and not flagged: #1/#2 redraws; #13/#15 P0 spending both Zeon Remnant Forces to kill Barbatos 1st Form (2-for-1, but the resources were otherwise idle at Lv3 and it denied the damaged-attack draw); #22-#26 P1's double Adapt line; #30 P0 not attacking with Zaku II (it would be exposed to a free kill); #39-#49 P0's all-in turn 9 that left all its units rested (a race choice, and Close Combat plus the Marida ping killed Adapt+Akihiro without losing a unit); #54/#55 P1 trading Flauros and 2nd Form into P0's linked units; #66 P1 attacking with 2nd Form before pairing Mikazuki onto Ryusei-Go for a third attacker (a Burst then killed Ryusei-Go; a sequencing question, not clearly wrong).

findings.played: select GD02-054 Gundam Barbatos 1st Form (+Mikazuki) for ST04-013 Hawk of Endymion (return to hand)
findings.better: select GD05-060 Gundam Flauros (+Akihiro Altland, HP1) [select(79)]
findings.reason: Bouncing a linked unit only taxes resources, because the unit and pilot return to hand and can be replayed linked and attack the same turn. Flauros+Akihiro costs 5 to redeploy versus 3 for 1st Form+Mikazuki, and has the highest AP (6). Replaying 1st Form also gives P1 another Mikazuki [When Paired] ping. P0 was at 3 shields facing 4 attackers, so the bigger tax mattered. Arguable because P0 kept a second Hawk for P1's turn.

findings.better: attack the player with GD02-058 Ryusei-Go and GD05-060 Gundam Flauros, keeping the Blockers (McGillis' Schwalbe Graze, Shiden Custom) home. Or go for lethal by also pairing Mikazuki onto Shiden Custom (linked) and attacking with McGillis.
findings.reason: P0 had 3 shields, no base and no Blocker; its only unit was an active Gundam (MA Form)+Sayla. P1 had three ready attackers (Ryusei-Go, Flauros, McGillis) and 2 spare resources to link a fourth, which is a possible lethal. Even the safe version (two attacks, Blockers home) costs nothing: P0 needs two unblocked attacks to win, and attacking the 1-HP rested units with its Gundam would be a trade at best. Ending the turn without attacking gave P0 a free turn, which it used to bounce a Blocker and kill McGillis. Not missed_lethal, because P0 had 5 open resources and 4 hidden cards.

items.notes: Considered and not flagged: #1/#2 mulligans; #19 P0 holding Sayla with 1 resource left; #29/#16 Guntanks deployed without a [Deploy] target (the bodies were still worth their cost); #41 P0 Guntank attacking face (P1 to 1 shield) instead of trading with the 1-HP Flauros (a race decision while far ahead on shields); #59/#60 P0 holding Hawk, Intercept Orders and Unforeseen Incident for instant-speed use instead of clearing attackers in the main phase (defensible); #64-#67 P0 bouncing Shiden and resting McGillis at P1's end phase (coherent setup for a possible two-attack lethal); #69-#73 P0's turn 14 (lost on board either way); P1's lethal on turn 15 was executed correctly.
